shortDescription: Create and manage firewalls on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: force
options.description: Force the deletion of the Firewall when still in use.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the Hetzner Cloud Firewall to manage. Only required if no firewall O(name) is given.

options.name: name
options.description: The Name of the Hetzner Cloud Firewall to manage. Only required if no firewall O(id) is given, or the firewall does not exist.

options.name: rules
options.description: List of rules the firewall contain.
